fullPassage: What distinguishes recycling is not its importance, but rather the ease with which individuals can participate, and the visibility of actions taken to promote the common good. You may care passionately about the threat of global warming or the destruction of the rain forests — but you can't have an immediate effect on these problems that is perceptible to yourself or others. The rain forest salvation truck doesn't make weekly pickups, let alone the clean air truck. When a public opinion poll in 1990 asked people what they had done in connection with environmental problems, 80 to 85% answered that they or their households had participated in various aspects of recycling; no other significant steps had been taken by a majority of respondents. Like the drunk looking for his wallet under the lamppost, we may focus on recycling because it is the easiest thing we can do.

det.korean: ③ delayed → immediate: 지구온난화·열대우림 파괴 같은 거대한 문제에 개인이 '즉각적인(immediate)' 영향을 미칠 수 없다는 맥락. '지연된(delayed)'으로 바꾸면 문맥상 모순.

✅ ④ ease: not its importance, but rather the ~ with which individuals can participate — 대조 구조 완성
det.tip: not A but rather B: A 대신 B. A=importance → B=ease(대립어).

questions.passage: What distinguishes recycling is not its importance, but rather the ease with which individuals can participate, and the visibility of actions taken to promote the common good. You may care passionately about the threat of global warming or the destruction of the rain forests — but you can't have an immediate effect on these problems that is perceptible to yourself or others. The rain forest salvation truck doesn't make weekly pickups, let alone the clean air truck. When a public opinion poll in 1990 asked people what they had done in connection with environmental problems, 80 to 85% answered that they or their households had participated in various aspects of recycling; no other significant steps had been taken by a majority of respondents. Like <u>the drunk looking for his wallet under the lamppost</u>, we may focus on recycling because it is the easiest thing we can do.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: '가로등 아래에서 지갑을 찾는 취객' 비유는 '실제로 잃어버린 곳(어두워서 보이지 않음)'이 아니라 '찾기 쉬운 곳(밝은 곳)'에서 찾는 행동. 본문에서는 거대한 환경 문제를 피하고 쉬운 재활용에만 집중하는 태도를 비유함.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 대중교통 비유 — 관련 없음
✅ ② 본질 회피 + 쉬운 일 집중 — 비유의 핵심 메시지
❌ ③ 야간 안전 주제 — 글의 주제와 무관
❌ ④ 알코올 중독 — 비유의 외형 소재일 뿐 핵심 아님
det.tip: 가로등 밑 찾기 비유 = 접근성 때문에 본질 회피. 어려운 문제 회피 + 쉬운 활동 몰입 = 본문 주장과 연결.
